Mistress Lin teaches tai chi in the Field of Morrows at dusk, on the flat grass near the east tree line; the player has begun to learn the opening form from her.

actors.look: elderly woman in flowing grey robes
actors.says: Your stance is stiff, loosen your shoulders.

props.name: Mistress Lin's kneeling cushion at the edge of the practice ground

lines.Mistress Lin: Stand where the grass is flat, let your shoulders fall, and breathe as the mist breathes; we begin with the opening form.
lines.narration: Mistress Lin turns her palms slowly, and the dusk mist seems to move with her.
lines.Zankaris: I held a sword all my life, and never once stood as still as she does.
